purpose: Twelve scene contracts plus synthetic negative branches for reviewer-facing risk/compliance traceability.

scene_contracts.minimum_data_rule: Only public directory version, user-provided request, consent state, required accommodation and human receipt may enter the scene.
scene_contracts.raci_rule: Responsible and accountable role types must be visible before state changes; real organisations are not named until authorised.
scene_contracts.success_evidence_rule: Success requires a human-readable receipt plus ordinary/AI-off fallback and exit asset.
